Good to know

Before we build together.

Do I need technical or AI experience?

No. The portfolio is designed around practical, accessible experiences. Individual products have their own requirements, so explore the relevant venture for details.

Is Foundry Finn free?

Yes. The Foundry Finn report is a free starting point to help clarify your business concept and next steps.

Are all ventures the same product?

No. Each venture has a distinct purpose, audience, and offer. Think Tank Solutions AI is the parent hub that helps you discover the right fit.

Can I ask about a custom system?

Yes. Use the inquiry form to describe the workflow, problem or project you want to address.

Privacy

Your inquiry. Your information.

Think Tank Solutions AI collects the name, email, business or project name, venture interest, and message you submit so we can review and respond to your inquiry. Inquiries are intended for the existing site database and are not published on this website or sold. Technical request information may be processed by the hosting provider to operate and protect the service. Use this form to request access, correction, or deletion of an earlier inquiry. Include its reference and use the same email address so we can verify your request. Please do not include confidential, financial, medical, or other sensitive records. Submitting an inquiry does not subscribe you to marketing emails.
